label: FINAL

source.name: BGT (Basisregistratie Grootschalige Topografie) via PDOK OGC API Features

licence.note: the API links CC0 1.0, the NGR dataset metadata says CC BY 4.0 with attribution; attribute 'Kadaster, BGT' to satisfy both

params.ground: median z of AHN class-2 points within ground_radius_m
params.voxel_grid: floor((xyz - LAS header mins) / 0.5), approximates Open3D voxel_down_sample

missed_candidates: skipped: results/ holds no coordinates for the 23 missed candidate groups
notes: BGT returns all versions of an object; only versions without eind_registratie / termination_date count
bbox query = geometry intersects the box; then kept strictly x0 <= x < x1, y0 <= y < y1 like the crop
BGT 'type' for these objects is 'niet-bgt' (optional IMGeo plus-content kept by the municipality); plus_type is the type shown
first_created after the AHN flight (2023-04-05) means the object may not have stood there when flown
points above 1.5 m within 0.6 m can also be tree canopy or a roof over the pole; see ahn_classes_above (AHN class 6 = building, 26 = civil structure / kunstwerk)
the OVL export is from 25 Nov 2021 and lists municipal lights only
OSM is crowd-sourced; no highway=street_lamp is mapped here
